scope: Scientific rewards, motivation, social incentives and post-withdrawal durability; targeted review, not systematic PRISMA.
sources_reviewed_definition: Sum of requested numResults, not actually read scientific papers.

searches.query: category:research paper randomized clinical trial gamification financial incentives physical activity follow-up after incentives withdrawn BE ACTIVE STEP UP 2024 Circulation 1062 participants
searches.objective: Prioritize original randomized trials from journal publishers or PubMed/PMC; extract sample size, intervention duration, follow-up and effects; exclude vendor summaries.

searches.objective: Find original published trials dated on or before 25 October 2026 that update BE ACTIVE/STEP UP evidence; prioritize randomized field trials and full source-owned texts, exclude protocols reviews preprints and publications dated after cutoff.
